prompt: Make a very rare armor that grants excellent AC, resistance to common damage, flight, advantage on saves, and a damaging retaliation effect.
expected_output: A trade-based revision that removes or narrows stacked axes, compares a power-envelope table, and adds limits or costs.

assertions.text: Refuses to keep maximum offense, defense, mobility, and utility merely because the rarity is high
Shows a power-envelope comparison and concrete trades (remove, narrow, cost, or frequency limit)
Audits effective defense, action economy, stacking, and attunement
Provides concrete tuning knobs and explains the strongest remaining axis
